new.title: Shared Boolean circuits rank and select in every parameter fiber of a layered binary automaton
new.statement:
∀ (l q : ℕ), 0 < l → ∀ (start : Fin q)
  (step : Fin l → Fin q → Bool → Bool → Fin q) (final : Fin q → Bool),
  let W := Fin l → Bool
  let good := fun p : W => Finset.univ.filter (fun u : W =>
    final ((List.finRange l).foldl (fun st j => step j st (p j) (u j)) start) = true)
  let key := fun w : W => ∑ i : Fin l, if w i then 2^(l-1-i.val) else 0
  let valid := fun C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2*l) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 512*(l+1)^2*(q+1)^2 ∧
    ∀ g ∈ C.gates, ((g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) ∨
      (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)
  ∃ (enc dec : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (ew : Fin l → Fin (2*l+enc.size)) (dw : Fin l → Fin (2*l+dec.size))
    (select : (p : W) → Fin (good p).card ≃ ↥(good p)),
    valid enc ∧ valid dec ∧ ∀ (p : W) (r : Fin (good p).card) (j : Fin l),
      let word := (select p r).val
      let idx := fun i : Fin l => r.val.testBit i.val
      ((good p).filter (fun other => key other < key word)).card = r.val ∧
      (enc.wires (List.ofFn p ++ List.ofFn idx)).getD (ew j).val false = word j ∧
      (dec.wires (List.ofFn p ++ List.ofFn word)).getD (dw j).val false = idx j
new.unlocks: indexes all parameter fibers with one ranking circuit and one selection circuit
new.context: Use the parameter bits as circuit inputs. From the last layer backwards compute all completion counts in l+1 bits. For each state, a parameter bit selects the applicable child pair and a ripple adder sums their counts. Traverse forward with a one-hot state. Selection compares the index to the zero-child count and subtracts it on a one branch. Ranking adds that count on each one branch. The prefix intervals partition the accepted words. Both fixed circuits serve every parameter, including empty fibers.

new.title: One coordinate-selector matching attains the finite gain below inverse color count for every admissible Boolean gate menu
new.statement:
∀ (k addrBits : ℕ), 4 ≤ addrBits → 2^addrBits ≤ k →
  let N := 2^k
  let r := 2^addrBits
  let I := Fin N
  let G := fun (x y : I) => x.val.testBit (y.val % r)
  let rad := fun (f : Bool → Bool → Bool) =>
    let ones := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Bool × Bool)).filter (fun z => f z.1 z.2)).card
    if ones = 0 ∨ ones = 4 then 1 else if ones = 2 then 2 else 3
  let errors := fun (q : ℕ) (op : Fin q → Bool → Bool → Bool) (π : Equiv.Perm I)
      (rf cf : I → Bool) (R C : Fin q → I → Bool) (out : Finset I → (Fin q → Bool) → Bool) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun z =>
      out {z.1,z.2} (fun t => op t (R t z.1) (C t (π z.2))) ≠
        xor (G z.1 (π z.2)) (xor (rf z.1) (cf (π z.2))))).card
  (∀ (q : ℕ) (op : Fin q → Bool → Bool → Bool),
    let D := ∏ t : Fin q, rad (op t)
    ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm I) (rf cf : I → Bool) (R C : Fin q → I → Bool)
      (out : Finset I → (Fin q → Bool) → Bool),
      r*N^2 ≤ 4*r*D*errors q op π rf cf R C out + 2*addrBits*D*N^2) ∧
  ∃ (π : Equiv.Perm I) (flip : I → Bool), ∀ (q : ℕ) (op : Fin q → Bool → Bool → Bool),
    let D := ∏ t : Fin q, rad (op t)
    addrBits*D ≤ r → ∃ (R C : Fin q → I → Bool) (out : Finset I → (Fin q → Bool) → Bool),
      256*r*D*errors q op π flip (fun _ => false) R C out + addrBits*D*N^2 ≤ 64*r*N^2
new.unlocks: Gives an explicit coordinate selector whose paired-decoder error has leading term 1/(4D) and finite saving of order a/r throughout a range of gate menus.
new.context: Group matched labels by their gate digits. On a class of h names the hidden selector bound gives h²≤4e+2a(N/r)h. Sum and use Cauchy. new.statement:
∀ (n q : ℕ) (op : Fin q → Bool → Bool → Bool),
  let I := Fin n

    let ones := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Bool × Bool)).filter (fun z => f z.1 z.2)).card
    if ones = 0 ∨ ones = 4 then 1 else if ones = 2 then 2 else 3
  let D := ∏ t : Fin q, rad (op t)
  ∀ (H : I → I → Bool) (π : Equiv.Perm I) (e : ℕ),
    (∃ (R C : Fin q → I → Bool) (out : Finset I → (Fin q → Bool) → Bool),

        out {z.1,z.2} (fun t => op t (R t z.1) (C t (π z.2))) ≠ H z.1 (π z.2))).card ≤ e) ↔
    ∃ label : I → Fin D,
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun z =>
        z.1 < z.2 ∧ label z.1 = label z.2 ∧ H z.1 (π z.2) ≠ H z.2 (π z.1))).card ≤ e

changed.title: Sixteen scheduled columns obstruct every shift-12 mate lookup on the four-round 17-bit row zero
changed.statement:
let k : Nat := 17
let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
  ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
  (List.range k).foldl (fun acc b =>
    acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit b)
      (!(word.testBit ((b + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((b + 2) % k))).toNat <<< b)) 0
let output := fun (w : Nat) =>
  ((List.range 4).foldl (fun x t =>
    step (x ^^^ rot 1 x ^^^ rot (k - 1) x) ^^^ rot (2 * t) w ^^^
      (3 ^ (k + (t + 1)) % 2 ^ k)) (rot 1 w)) >>> 8
let columnPass := fun (key name : Nat) =>
  ((List.range 4).foldl (fun state j =>
    step (state ^^^ rot 2 state ^^^ rot (k - 2) state) ^^^
      rot (3 * (j + 1) + 1) key ^^^ (3 ^ (k + (4 + (j + 1))) % 2 ^ k))
    (rot 3 key ^^^ name)) < 2 ^ 8
let keys := List.range (2 ^ k)
∀ lookup : Nat → Bool, ∃ column : Fin (2 ^ k),
  column.val ∈ ([0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 18, 22, 26, 29] : List Nat) ∧
  ¬ ((∃ w ∈ keys, output w = 0 ∧ columnPass w column.val) ↔
    (∃ candidate ∈ keys,
      (if candidate.testBit 2 then output candidate = 0
       else lookup (output (candidate ^^^ 12)) = true) ∧ columnPass candidate column.val))

changed.title: Exact weighted average support of binary parity contradictions when deleting any one equation preserves inconsistency
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (row : Fin m → Fin n → ZMod 2) (rhs : Fin m → ZMod 2),
  let ok := fun (rows : Finset (Fin m)) => ∃ x : Fin n → ZMod 2,
    ∀ e ∈ rows, (∑ j, row e j * x j) = rhs e
  let W := Finset.univ.filter (fun indices : Finset (Fin m) =>
    (∀ j : Fin n, indices.sum (fun e => row e j) = 0) ∧ indices.sum rhs = 1)
  ¬ ok Finset.univ → (∀ e : Fin m, ¬ ok (Finset.univ.erase e)) →
    W.Nonempty ∧
    (∀ e ∈ W.biUnion id, 2*(W.filter (fun subset => e ∈ subset)).card = W.card) ∧
    ∀ w : Fin m → ℕ,
      2*W.sum (fun support => support.sum w) = W.card * (W.biUnion id).sum w ∧
      ∃ D ∈ W, 2*D.sum w ≤ (W.biUnion id).sum w
